title: Neon Green Dog Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a vibrant lime-green dog with bright pink eyes, a wide smiling mouth, and tongue out. It wears a spiked collar with skull charms and has a barcode tattoo on its cheek reading 'DEATH'.
prompt: Close-up surreal portrait of a bright lime-green Labrador with glowing pink eyes, tongue out, and happy expression. It wears a heavy spiked collar with hanging skulls and chains. A purple barcode on its cheek reads DEATH. In the background, a giant ominous owl flies over a dark tower with a car on top, a floating purple planet, burning pizza, and a smoky apocalyptic sky.
